name: Anatomy and Physiology
description: Explore the complex inner workings of the human body. Participants will demonstrate their knowledge of the digestive, immune, and respiratory systems and how they fight off illness.

name: Astronomy
description: Journey through the cosmos to uncover the mysteries of deep space. Teams will demonstrate their understanding of stellar evolution, star formation, and celestial objects.

name: Boomilever
description: Put your engineering skills to the test. Teams design, build, and test a lightweight Boomilever structure engineered to support a maximum load with the highest structural efficiency.

name: Botany
description: Explore the vital world of plant biology. Participants will be tested on their knowledge of agriculture, botany principles, and how plant life sustains our planet.

name: Chemistry Lab
description: Apply your knowledge of chemical processes in a laboratory setting. Teams will complete hands-on tasks and analyze data focusing on kinetics and gases.

name: Circuit Lab
description: Explore the forces that power our modern world. Participants will complete tasks and answer questions related to electricity, magnetism, and direct current (DC) circuits.

name: Codebusters
description: Race against the clock to crack secret codes. Teams will use cryptanalysis techniques to decipher hidden messages and solve complex historical and modern ciphers.

name: Crime Busters
description: Step into the role of a forensic investigator. Given a scenario and physical evidence, students will perform a series of tests to analyze powders and liquids to solve a crime.

name: Designer Genes
description: Unlock the blueprint of life. Participants will solve problems and analyze data related to genetics, DNA, molecular biology, and biotechnology.

name: Disease Detectives
description: Use your investigative skills to act as a medical detective. Students will study disease outbreaks, health, and epidemiology to learn how public health professionals save lives.

name: Dynamic Planet
description: Investigate the powerful processes that shape our dynamic world. Teams will demonstrate their understanding of large-scale geological forces, with a special focus on Earth's fresh waters.

name: Electric Vehicle
description: Design and build a precise, electric-powered vehicle. Teams must engineer their device to travel quickly and stop as close as possible to a specific target point.

name: Engineering CAD
description: Bring your ideas to life in 3D. Teams will use computer-aided design (CAD) software to model objects with precision and design innovative solutions to engineering problems.

name: Experimental Design
description: Design, execute, and analyze a complete experiment from scratch. This event tests a team's ability to conduct scientific inquiry and report findings entirely on-site using provided materials.

name: Food Science
description: Discover the science behind what we eat. Participants will study the chemistry of food and perform practical lab experiments related to food science.

name: Forensics
description: Use advanced laboratory techniques to solve a mystery. Students will identify powders, polymers, and analyze chromatography to piece together evidence and catch a suspect.

name: Glider
description: Design and construct a graceful, free-flight glider. Participants will engineer their aircraft to achieve maximum flight time and aerodynamic efficiency.

name: Heredity
description: Discover how traits are passed down through generations. Participants will solve genetic puzzles and analyze data related to basic heredity principles.

name: Hovercraft
description: Design and build a self-propelled hovercraft. Competitors will construct a device that levitates and glides down a track while also demonstrating their knowledge of classical mechanics.

name: Meteorology
description: Master the science behind the atmosphere's most dramatic phenomena. This event emphasizes basic meteorological principles with a special focus on severe storms.

name: Mission Possible
description: Design a creative, Rube Goldberg-style chain reaction. Participants will build and document a device that completes a simple final action through a complex series of energy transfers.

name: Ping Pong Parachute
description: Engineer a powerful bottle rocket. Teams will design and build a pressurized rocket to launch a parachute-suspended ping pong ball, aiming for the maximum time aloft.

name: Protein Modeling
description: Explore molecular biology in 3D. Students will use computer visualization and physical modeling tools to understand the intricate structure and function of specific proteins.

name: Remote Sensing
description: See the world from above. Participants will use cutting-edge satellite imagery, remote sensing data, and computational skills to analyze Earth's changing landscapes.

name: Rocks and Minerals
description: Dig into Earth's geological history. Teams will demonstrate their knowledge by identifying rock and mineral specimens and answering questions about their properties and formation.

name: Roller Coaster
description: Design an exciting, gravity-powered track. Teams will build and test a Roller Coaster that precisely controls the speed of a rolling sphere to achieve a target time.

name: Scrambler
description: Engineer a fast, mechanical vehicle to protect an egg. Competitors will use energy from a falling mass to transport their fragile cargo quickly and stop as close to a terminal barrier as possible.

name: Solar System
description: Embark on an interplanetary exploration. Students will demonstrate their understanding of the geologic characteristics, evolution, and cosmic wonders of the rocky bodies in our solar neighborhood.

name: Thermodynamics
description: Master the science of heat flow. Teams will design an efficient insulating device to retain heat and demonstrate their knowledge of thermal energy concepts.

name: Water Quality
description: Dive into aquatic ecology. Participants will be assessed on their understanding of water systems, with a focus on evaluating and preserving the health of marine and estuary environments.

name: Wright Stuff
description: Craft a delicate, rubber-band powered airplane. Teams will design, construct, and test their free-flight monoplanes to achieve maximum time aloft.

name: Write It Do It
description: Test your communication and teamwork skills. One partner writes detailed instructions for a mystery object, and the other attempts to recreate it perfectly using only those written directions.
